$description: Values the Figma frames use that are NOT in the 'dashboard variables' collection (Figma styles, raw fills, layout constants from the brief). Hand-maintained; each entry notes where it came from. Default.tokens.json stays untouched.

composer.source: Analytics > Hop — Agent panel > Composer > Input

toggle-thumb.source: Analytics - Last week selected > Mode toggle > Row / Last week

screenshot-card.source: History — asked on another page (screenshot) > Screenshot

swatch-emerald.source: Analytics > Card/Top revenue generators > Satin slip dress (Emerald)

swatch-indigo.source: Analytics > Card/Top revenue generators > Wrap kimono (Indigo)

post-sand-reel.source: Analytics — Instagram likes selected > Post/Styling the Sand set 3 ways

post-fit-check.source: Analytics — Instagram likes selected > Post/Fit check: Tolu in Sand

swatch-ecru.source: Inventory — nothing selected, jump chips stay > Stock table > Wide-leg trousers Ecru

swatch-adire.source: Inventory — nothing selected, jump chips stay > Stock table > Adire shirt dress Blue

swatch-rust.source: Inventory — nothing selected, jump chips stay > Stock table > Silk scarf Rust

panel.source: brief A6 / Analytics > Hop — Agent panel. Also the side panel's maximum (and default) width — it can be dragged narrower (user feedback 2026-09-29)

bar.source: brief A6 / Top bar + Agent header

panel-rail.source: example 2 (1913:334) > Hop - Agent panel, collapsed (62 + 1px border)

chain.source: History — asked on Analytics > Split > Brief chain (360 wide)

snapshot.source: History — asked on another page > Content > Screenshot card height

main-min.source: Not in Figma: the narrowest page area before the Analytics KPI tabs overlap (phase 8 zoom check; Figma draws it at 824). Below this the workspace scrolls sideways instead of squashing.

panel-min.source: Not in Figma: the narrowest the side panel can be dragged (user left the minimum to us, 2026-09-29) — keeps the jump chips on one line and the History chain readable

hop-glow.source: Agent character > Eye left/right drop shadow (blur 4, #2BB35A at 70%)

override.$description: Figma variables changed after the last JSON export. gen-tokens applies these over design/Default.tokens.json (which is never edited by hand).
